== Acquisition ==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
* [[Ghial the Bone Dancer]] ([[Xaquang Skyway]])

== Notes ==
* This skill is the only player skill that can spawn exploitable corpses. 
* The corpses created by this skill will count as dead allies for the purpose of [["I Will Avenge You!"]].
* Multiple additional exploitable corpses have a few notable consequences:
** [[Taste of Death]] or [[Feast for the Dead]] can be used more effectively, for instance, to respectively make [[Blood of the Master]] safer or keep the minion army alive longer.
** Allows a team to carry multiple corpse exploitation skills without worrying about running out of corpses. 
** Allows a [[minion master]] to always have one Flesh Golem and a few other minions alive, even in areas where exploitable corpses are scarce, as long as the team can find at least one corpse to animate the first golem.
*** A player or hero bringing [[sacrifice]] skills, such as a [[saccer]] or a [[Blood is Power]] build, can kill themselves to provide this initial corpse.
* A Flesh Golem's size is determined by its level; the higher the level, the larger the minion.
{{bug|On some very rare occasions, living NPCs will spawn rather than corpses when the golem dies.}}

== Trivia ==
* The spawned corpses can be those of a [[Norn Commoner]], [[Canthan Peasant]], [[Unsuccessful Novice]] or [[Istani Peasant]].
